newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 6.

text.p: Mitsui Mining and Smelting Co Ltd workers and management have agreed to a new wage system to be introduced in the fiscal year starting April 1997. The company will limit pay hikes in principle to annual increases, while bonus payments will depend upon corporate performance.

Kurabo Industries Ltd is expected to post parent current profit of 370 million yen for the half year ended September 30, down 14 percent from the same period a year earlier. The smaller-than-expected decline in profit is due to strong sales of housing-related materials and businesses.

NTT Data Communications System Corp plans to start designing an information service for medium-sized brokerage houses to help them to cut costs. NTT Data hopes for annual sales of 10 billion yen five years after starting the service in 1999.
